content: The Switch Driver management API’s: EthSwt_EthRxProcessFrame(), EthSwt_EthRxFinishedIndication(), EthSwt_EthTxPrepareFrame(), EthSwt_EthTxAdaptBufferLength(), EthSwt_EthTxProcessFrame() and EthSwt _EthTxFinishedIndication() Specification of Ethernet Driver AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 19 of 92 Document ID 430 : AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetDriver - AUTOSAR confidential - shall be used to to inform the Switch Driver about a required special treatment for Switch management purpose (see document AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetInterface).

The Switch Driver management API’s: EthSwt_EthRxProcessFrame(), EthSwt_EthRxFinishedIndication(), EthSwt_EthTxPrepareFrame(), EthSwt_EthTxAdaptBufferLength(), Specification of Ethernet Driver AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 19 of 102 Document ID 430 : AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetDriver EthSwt_EthTxProcessFrame() and EthSwt _EthTxFinishedIndication() shall be used to to inform the Switch Driver about a required special treatment for Switch management purpose (see document AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetInterface).

The Switch Driver management API's: • EthSwt_EthRxProcessFrame(), • EthSwt_EthRxFinishedIndication(), • EthSwt_EthTxPrepareFrame(), • EthSwt_EthTxAdaptBufferLength(), • EthSwt_EthTxProcessFrame() and • EthSwt_EthTxFinishedIndication() shall be used to to inform the Switch Driver about a required special treatment for Switch management purpose (see document AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetInterface [4]).

The Switch Driver management API's: • EthSwt_EthRxProcessFrame(), • EthSwt_EthRxFinishedIndication(), • EthSwt_EthTxPrepareFrame(), • EthSwt_EthTxAdaptBufferLength(), • EthSwt_EthTxProcessFrame() and • EthSwt_EthTxFinishedIndication() shall be used to to inform the Switch Driver about a required special treatment for Switch management purpose (see document AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetInterface [4]).
